course.title: Stop Chasing. Start Trading the EMA.
course.summary: Stop buying every EMA touch. Learn which setups deserve attention, where they fail, and when the best trade is no trade.
course.description: An approximately 50-minute practical EMA strategy course for traders who already understand moving averages. Focus on market qualification, trend pullbacks, EMA reclaims and rejections, continuation entries, no-trade conditions, late entries, invalidation, loss control and building a testable playbook. It is not an EMA basics course and does not promise a profitable strategy.

prompts.label: Qualify
prompts.text: What is the market condition, and is it suitable for this setup? State the evidence.

prompts.label: Plan
prompts.text: What must price do before entry? Where is the idea invalidated, and is there enough room?

prompts.label: Review
prompts.text: Was the decision consistent with the plan? Separate process quality from the trade outcome.

modules.title: Find Trades Worth Taking
modules.summary: Qualify market conditions, recognise the core EMA setups and plan entries without chasing price.

lessons.title: Qualify the Market Before Looking for an Entry
lessons.summary: Start with market regime, structure and location. Decide whether an EMA setup is even worth looking for.

lessons.title: The Trend-Pullback Setup
lessons.summary: Plan a pullback in an established trend without treating every touch of the EMA as an entry.

lessons.title: The EMA Reclaim and Rejection Setup
lessons.summary: Read a reclaim or rejection through price structure, follow-through and a defined invalidation point.

lessons.title: Breakout, Retest and Trend Continuation
lessons.summary: Separate a genuine continuation opportunity from a late breakout chase.

modules.title: Stay Out and Avoid Failure
modules.summary: Recognise poor conditions, late entries, failed setups and the evidence that should stop a trade.

lessons.title: The No-Trade Market
lessons.summary: Recognise chop, compression without direction, overlapping averages and conflicting structure.

lessons.title: Late Entries, Extended Price and Poor Location
lessons.summary: Avoid entering after the move has already travelled too far or left too little room.

lessons.title: Failed Setups, Invalidation and Loss Control
lessons.summary: Know what would prove the trade idea wrong, and respond without widening risk.

lessons.title: Test the Idea and Build Your EMA Playbook
lessons.summary: Turn the setups and skip rules into a testable personal process with a decision journal.
